name: Unflinching Chainhead
description: Keep the chain turning in a small slow circle at the hip so the orbit already spins when the fight begins.

name: Granite Whiplink
description: The turn of the hip carries the circling tip out of the orbit into a sudden flat strike at the ribs.

name: Hastening Hingebar
description: Step across the line of the orbit so the foe is drawn into the path of the swinging tip.

name: Rumblewrithe
description: Turn the orbit against the foe's thrust so the shaft is swept off its line by the passing segments.

name: Granite Eyelet
description: Qi widens the orbit with each turn until the tip strikes from the far edge of the circle with full weight.

name: Joint Hauberk
description: Hold the orbit before the body with a steady stream of qi so the circle works as a moving guard.

name: Granite Spineplate
description: Launch the whole orbit outward so that qi-charged iron sweeps every foe standing near the wielder.

name: Fastening Coilend
description: The orbit collapses inward around the foe's arms and holds them against the body with steady qi.

name: Aegis Tailblade
description: Grip so that the chain can unroll from the hand in a spiral without snagging the wrist.

name: Tempered Linkpin
description: The chain unwinds in the air and the tip arrives with a corkscrew twist that slips past a parry.

name: Rattleplating
description: Draw the chain back along a spiral so that it winds the foe's weapon hand into a turn and loosens the grip.

name: Gust Slither
description: Walk a spiral path inward around the foe so each step shortens the circle and the chain follows.

name: Drubbing Rasp
description: Qi spins the tip as it flies and bores through a leather or hide guard like a drill.

name: Jointplating
description: A coil of chain winds up the forearm and blows slide along its turns and off the arm.

name: Gyve Writhe
description: The spiral tightens with each of the wielder's breaths until the foe's arm can no longer bend.

name: Cleaving Jangle
description: Channel the whole length of the spiral into one point and punch through plate armor at its seam.

name: Charter Rivet
description: The spiral closes in a loose cage about the foe so that every attempt to move meets iron.

name: Aegis Segment
description: Rest the chain across the shoulders with a field of qi in each segment so it stirs at any approach.

name: Rumblerivet
description: Throw while the qi field tells the wielder where each segment is so the tip never wanders.

name: Murkjoint
description: The chain stirs on its own at a cut and rises to turn the blade before the wielder moves.

name: Chime Eyelet
description: Spread the qi field along the chain and feel whatever touches it as if the iron were skin.

name: Torrent Rattle
description: Glide forward with the chain lifted by the qi field so its weight no longer drags the stride.

name: Ponderous Coilend
description: Steer the chain with a turn of the fingers so it winds about a limb without a full throw.

name: Gust Rattle
description: The tip follows the foe's movement for a breath and curves in to strike where the foe has stepped.

name: Hingebar Greave
description: The chain bends around the wielder in a living ring that gives with a blow and returns its force.

name: Granite Rivet
description: Throw the chain and let its qi field steer it around a guard to strike the foe's blind side.

name: Siltrivet
description: Lay the chain along the ground with qi alive in it so it snaps up around any foot that crosses.

name: Chainhead Hauberk
description: Sink low with the chain trailing from the hand so the body is small and the iron wide.

name: Mightrasp
description: Cast the chain across the foe's body and rake the segments back along the cloth in one tearing pull.

name: Manacling Jangle
description: Catch the foe's raised arm on the chain and rake it down so the guard falls open.

name: Hoarfrost Writhe
description: Haul on a hooked strap with both hands and the weight of the whole body to drag the foe in.

name: Siltjangle
description: Pull the chain tight and use it as a pivot to step around a charging foe.

name: Adamant Spineplate
description: Retreat with the chain dragging across the front so each follow-up cut scrapes against iron.

name: Rumble Tailblade
description: Qi hardens the edge of every segment so a raking pull tears cloth and leather and the flesh beneath.

name: Hamstringing Segment
description: Hook the foe's weapon arm and drag it steadily across the body until the grip fails.

name: Rasp Onslaught
description: A heavy qi-fed cast drives one segment into the rim of a shield and splits the wood.

name: Raging Whiplink
description: Hook the plates of the foe's armor and rip them from their straps in one heavy qi-fed heave.

name: Harpooning Jangle
description: Spin the chain in a tight raking circle that tears at every foe within the swing's reach.

name: Iron Joint
description: Hold a chain in each hand so that each guard covers whatever the other leaves open.

name: Whiplink Thrash
description: The left tail goes high and the right tail low in one beat so the foe cannot guard both.

name: Murk Segment
description: Cross the two chains before the chest so that a descending cut meets two lines of iron.

name: Writhe Jaunt
description: Step so that each foot answers the opposite chain's swing and the body never leaves its balance.

name: Dominating Slither
description: Both tails wind about the foe from opposite sides and a pull from each hand holds the foe still.

name: Rivetlinctus
description: Pass qi from one chain to the other in time with the swing so that neither tail ever runs dry.

name: Hingebar Assault
description: One tail beats the guard aside and the other answers in the same breath through the opening.

name: Severing Spineplate
description: Both tails sweep in from opposite sides and close on the foe like shears with qi in every segment.

name: Intent Chainhead
description: Keep both tails turning in matched circles so the foe standing between cannot step without meeting iron.

name: Facetrivet
description: Stand poised on one foot like a perched hawk with the chain hanging ready from the raised hand.

name: Tempered Tailblade
description: Rise on the toes and throw steeply downward so the tip falls on the foe from above.

name: Rivet Spurt
description: Land from a leap so softly that the chain makes no sound and the next cast is ready.

name: Stifling Rattle
description: Snatch at the foe's weapon with the barbed tip and wrench it up and away from the hand.

name: Verityjoint
description: Raise the head and spread the senses wide to mark every foe like a hawk scanning a field.

name: Equipoise Coilend
description: Fall back in a long curve with the chain trailing so that pursuers meet the swinging tip.

name: Rivetplating
description: Spin the chain in beating arcs to either side so the whirling iron works like two wings.

name: Eyelet Torment
description: Dive in on a straight line and let the qi-loaded tip fall into the foe's chest.

name: Gyverivet
description: The barbed tip clamps on to the foe's shoulder like a claw and the chain draws the foe down.

name: Granite Slither
description: Ride a lift of qi from the ground to rise into the air for the length of one throw.

name: Sanguine Linkpin
description: Gather qi at the top of a leap and bring the whole chain down in a single hawk's fall.

name: Rattletorment
description: Cast the chain wide so it drops like a net of iron rings over every foe beneath the leap.

name: Steadfast Chainhead
description: Settle into a wide low stance with the chain gathered at the hips like water in a basin.

name: Vital Linkpin
description: Draw one thread of qi along each side of the chain until the segments hold a full measure.

name: Eyeletassault
description: Tip the stored qi forward into the throw so it pours into the foe with the tip's landing.

name: Eyelet Spurt
description: Flow forward in a widening stride that opens out like a river reaching the sea.

name: Skinning Rasp
description: Throw with every stored measure so the tip lands heavily and the surplus spills over the foe's guard.

name: Thornrivet
description: Two tracks of qi run along the chain in a pair of guarding arcs that overlap before the body.

name: Silt Hingebar
description: Break the basin all at once so the stored qi bursts out through the chain and strikes every foe near.

name: Ponderous Segment
description: Let the qi flow outward in a steady river that pushes the foe's stance and breath downward.

name: Aegis Joint
description: Face a chosen point on the horizon and set the feet so the chain hangs along that bearing.

name: Rasptorment
description: Cast along the held bearing so the tip flies on one unbending line to the foe's centre.

name: Racing Rivet
description: Lean into the wind and take the step the gust allows so the body moves with it.

name: Invigorating Spineplate
description: Listen to how the wind bends around a foe's shape and read the foe's position from it.

name: Unyielding Tailblade
description: Fall back across open ground with the chain swinging wide to keep a charging foe at a distance.

name: Sanguine Rattle
description: Hold the bearing through the whole throw with a thread of qi and the tip lands exactly where it was sent.

name: Hoarfrost Joint
description: The chain winds about the foe and the wielder stands fast on the bearing so the wrap cannot be pulled loose.

name: Rivethauberk
description: Spin the chain on the windward side so the wind itself leans against any blow from that quarter.

name: Harpooning Slither
description: Drive the whole sworn line into the tip so it breaks the foe's bearing and pierces the guard.

name: Quelling Shade Whiplink
description: Cast the chain across the foe and let the wind drag it down so the foe's legs bend and sink.

name: Coilend Cloak
description: Stand near the plateau's edge with the chain hanging into the updraft so it floats ready.

name: Janglethrash
description: Time the throw to a rising gust so the wind lifts the tip farther than the arm could.

name: Torrent Writhe
description: Walk the rim in even strides with the chain on the outer side as a counterweight against the drop.

name: Mayhem Joint
description: Haul the chain back as a gust strikes and its push adds to the pull that drags the foe off balance.

name: Scorching Rasp
description: Flick the tip upward on a rising gust so that it catches the foe's chin before the guard drops.

name: Hamstringing Eyelet
description: The wind winds the loose end of the chain about the foe and a thread of qi locks the turns.

name: Unbroken Linkpin
description: Turn so the chain swings on the sheltered side and a cut meets the iron with the wind behind it.

name: Severing Jangle
description: Swing the chain with the full gale behind it and sweep every foe along the line of the wind.

name: Stifling Slither
description: Wrap the foe at the plateau's rim and drag the foe down and back so the foe cannot stand.

name: Charter Chainhead
description: Stand in the open with no cover and the chain loose at the side to show the wielder will not retreat behind anything.

name: Sanguine Segment
description: Throw from a bare stance with nothing held back so the tip flies straight at the foe's front.

name: Raspspurt
description: Pace the open ground in long strides that keep time with the wind and never favor a side.

name: Rumblerattle
description: Recall the chain along the sworn bearing so it snaps back through anything standing in the way.

name: Jointremedy
description: Read the gale through the chain and learn where a foe is hidden by the way the wind falls.

name: Resilient Tailblade
description: Sway with the chain hanging open so a cut passes through empty air and meets the swinging tip.

name: Tempered Spineplate
description: Send a thread of qi down the sworn line and the tip lands with the weight of the whole oath.

name: Thornjoint
description: The chain coils about the foe and holds fast for as long as the wielder stands to the oath.

name: Linkpin Fastness
description: The wind lifts the chain into a drifting circle around the wielder that softens each blow.

name: Drubbing Rivet
description: Let the whole chain fly free in the wind and lash every foe around the wielder without a wall between.

name: Intenteyelet
description: Plant the chain's end in the earth and hold the line so that foes pressing against the wind lose ground.
